title: Structured exclusion evidence
summary: Eligibility assessments retain stable reason codes for why each node was excluded, including jurisdiction/legal/trust/authority/ability/runtime/tag/architecture/resource/API-route/freshness failures plus external authority reasons. This evidence is operationally distinct from ranking score.
invariants: NO_NODE should be diagnosable as an eligibility/admission problem, not reduced to an opaque scheduling failure.
Reason codes are evidence for operations and policy analysis; they are not negative scores.
